# f5xc_forward_proxy_policy (Resource)

Forward Proxy policy defines access control rules for connections going via forward<br>Proxy. It is view type of config object that uses service policy mechanism to achieve<br>Required functionality.<br><br>View will create following child objects.<br><br>* Service Policy<br>* Service Policy Rule

To get more information about f5xc_forward_proxy_policy, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-forward-proxy-policy)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Forward Proxy Policy - Basic

resource "f5xc_forward_proxy_policy" "example" {
  name      = "example-forward-proxy-policy"
  namespace = "system"

  proxy_choice = {
    any_proxy = true
  }

  rule_choice = {
    allow_all = true
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Forward Proxy Policy - Full

resource "f5xc_forward_proxy_policy" "example" {
  name        = "example-forward-proxy-policy"
  namespace   = "system"
  description = "Full forward proxy policy example"

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "netops"
  }

  proxy_choice = {
    proxy_label_selector = {
      expressions = ["app == proxy"]
    }
  }

  rule_choice = {
    rule_list = {
      rules = [
        {
          metadata = {
            name        = "example-rule-full"
            description = "allow all sources to http destinations"
          }

          action = ["ALLOW"]

          source_choice = {
            prefix_list = {
              prefixes      = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
              ipv6_prefixes = ["2001:0db8:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000/64"]
            }
          }

          destination_choice = {
            http_list = {
              http_list = [
                {
                  domain_choice = {
                    exact_value = "api.example.com"
                  }
                  path_choice = {
                    any_path = true
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          }

          http_connect_choice = {
            port_matcher = {
              ports = ["443"]
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }

  segment_policy = {
    src_segment_choice = {
      src_any = true
    }
    dst_segment_choice = {
      dst_any = true
    }
  }
}
```

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_forward_proxy_policy.example <namespace>/<name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<name>"
	to = f5xc_forward_proxy_policy.example
}
```
